summary: 24 ranked options. Strongest: Run the Rock (Nov 3 registration deadline), Evergreen Singletrack Soirée, Walla Walla Fall Release, Coeur d'Alene CX finale, Grand Ridge 50K, Raging River volunteer day, and Yakima MTB film. NWAC reports early-season snow hazards; no reliable resort skiing or motorized snowmobile window confirmed. Mount Rainier Sunrise/Stevens Canyon closed, chains required on park roads Nov 1-May 1. Forecast details vary and must be checked again Friday.

recommendations.title: Run the Rock 50K / 25K / Half
recommendations.timing: Sat Nov 7: 50K 7 AM, 25K 9 AM; Sun Nov 8: half 8:30 AM
recommendations.location: Smith Rock State Park, Terrebonne, OR
recommendations.weather: Cold morning; possible rain/snow; verify Smith Rock forecast
recommendations.description: Signature Smith Rock and Gray Butte trails with ~5,000 ft gain in 50K; off-site DD Ranch shuttle parking. Online registration ends Nov 3; no race-day registration.
recommendations.why: A high-quality mountain-running race for the 2027 ultra build; deadline is today.

recommendations.title: Evergreen Singletrack Soirée
recommendations.weather: Indoor event; wet west-side travel possible
recommendations.description: Evergreen MTB Alliance fundraiser with rider/volunteer networking, comedian Scott Losse, live art, taco bar and silent auction. Member email confirms tickets selling.
recommendations.why: Unusually strong chance to meet riders and trail builders and develop lasting riding connections.

recommendations.title: Walla Walla Fall Release Weekend
recommendations.weather: Cool fall valley weather; indoor tastings
recommendations.description: Regional wineries release new vintages across downtown, Airport, Southside, Westside and other districts. Pair with a road or gravel ride.
recommendations.why: Excellent close-to-home seasonal event with an easy outdoor component.

recommendations.title: Be Yourself Cross — MTCX Super Prestige Finale
recommendations.cost: ~$25–$35 per race + USAC license if needed
recommendations.weather: Chilly; possible wet/muddy grass; verify forecast
recommendations.description: Two-day USA Cycling-sanctioned cyclocross finale with masters, open and singlespeed categories. Official venue is 1031 N Academic Way Dock B, Coeur d'Alene ID (some aggregator pages mislabel it Montana).
recommendations.why: Competitive bike racing within a manageable drive, with two race days.

recommendations.title: Grand Ridge 50K / Marathon / Half / 5 Mile
recommendations.weather: Cool, wet forest possible; technical slick trails
recommendations.description: Evergreen Trail Runs season finale; 50K has ~5,600 ft gain. Online registration closes Friday Nov 6 at noon.
recommendations.why: Challenging trail-running event with multiple distances and strong local running community.

recommendations.title: Raging River Fall Trail Maintenance + BBQ
recommendations.weather: Cool/wet; bring rain layers and gloves
recommendations.description: Evergreen work party clearing drains and debris on CCDH, Way Back, Reverance and Physical Therapy; meet Yellow Gate on SE 104 St off Hwy 18; BBQ and swag afterward.
recommendations.why: Trail stewardship and community connections at a destination you already ride.

recommendations.title: Freehub MTB Film at Single Hill Brewing
recommendations.weather: Outdoor patio screening; cold evening; dress warmly
recommendations.description: Freehub PRESENTS mountain-bike film hosted with Evergreen Cowlitz-Naches chapter; 90-minute film and a 2027 trail-planning/community discussion.
recommendations.why: Close-to-home MTB community event that is easy to combine with an afternoon ride.

recommendations.title: Willapa Trail Festival — 25K to 100 Miles
recommendations.weather: Wet/cool lowland gravel likely; check weather
recommendations.description: Flat hard-packed Willapa Hills rail trail with 25K, 50K, 50-mile and 100-mile formats. Third-party listing shows Nov 3 registration cutoff and notes permit pending; verify directly with organizer before travel.
recommendations.why: Low-cost long-distance endurance option and an unusual fast 50-miler.

recommendations.title: Deception Pass 50K / Marathon / 25K
recommendations.location: Deception Pass State Park, Oak Harbor, WA
recommendations.weather: Coastal wet/cold and slippery bluffs possible
recommendations.description: Rainshadow Running event with coastal trails, Deception Pass Bridge crossings and ~4,200 ft gain in the 50K; registration advertised by organizer.
recommendations.why: Exceptional farther-distance coastal trail-running experience.

recommendations.title: Grenache Fest + M. Ward
recommendations.weather: Indoor tastings/concert; cool outside
recommendations.description: Focused Grenache wine festival with blind tastings, 30 producers, food trucks and an evening M. Ward concert.
recommendations.why: Unusual one-day regional food/wine and music combination.

recommendations.title: Beacon Hill Fire Recovery Reseeding
recommendations.location: Beacon Hill / Camp Sekani, Spokane, WA
recommendations.weather: Cold; bring rain layers and sturdy footwear
recommendations.description: Evergreen East chapter reseeding fire-affected areas at Sekani; meet at Boulder Beach parking lot because Sekani parking is closed for construction.
recommendations.why: Meaningful trail stewardship with local Spokane riders.

recommendations.title: Oak Hill School Supercross
recommendations.weather: Likely wet/muddy grass and off-cambers
recommendations.description: Two-day OBRA cyclocross at Oak Hill School; prereg closes Fri Nov 6 at 4 PM, onsite registration offered.
recommendations.why: A farther but distinctive muddy cyclocross weekend.

recommendations.title: Fall Flash of the Palouse 10K / 5K
recommendations.weather: Chilly fall morning; road/gravel mix
recommendations.description: Palouse Road Runners event; rolling paved/gravel 10K and flat 5K; registration listed through Nov 5.
recommendations.why: Short-distance speed work with a local running community.

recommendations.title: Crystal Mountain Winter Stoke Block Party
recommendations.weather: Outdoor event; cold and possible showers
recommendations.description: Crystal Mountain's preseason gathering with live music, vendors, giveaways, games and a fundraiser raffle.
recommendations.why: Strong ski-community event without pretending the ski season is open.

recommendations.title: Bubbles & Bites — Prosser
recommendations.location: Walter Clore Wine & Culinary Center, Prosser, WA
recommendations.cost: $20 incl. four tasting scrip; limited 300 tickets
recommendations.weather: Indoor event
recommendations.description: Sparkling wines from Prosser producers with sweet/savory bites by local chefs; limited-ticket event.
recommendations.why: Low-travel food and wine outing after a ride.

recommendations.title: Jo Koy — Koy Meets World Tour
recommendations.weather: Indoor arena
recommendations.description: Major stand-up comedy tour at Toyota Center; official venue and Live Nation both list tickets.
recommendations.why: Rare arena-scale entertainment close to home.

recommendations.title: Sip & Stroll — Downtown Yakima
recommendations.weather: Indoor stops; cool between venues
recommendations.description: Craft beverage walk with 18 participating downtown businesses; age 21+.
recommendations.why: Pair with a morning bike ride or the MTB film that evening.

recommendations.title: Spokane Symphony — The Pastoral
recommendations.timing: Sat Nov 7, 7:30 PM; Sun Nov 8, 3 PM
recommendations.location: Martin Woldson Theater at the Fox, Spokane, WA
recommendations.weather: Indoor
recommendations.description: Beethoven's Pastoral Symphony and Sibelius violin concerto with Yvette Kraft and Sameer Patel.
recommendations.why: Quality evening option to pair with Spokane cycling or trail work.

recommendations.title: Walla Walla Gravel + Fall Release
recommendations.weather: Cool, wind possible; stay on dry lower-elevation roads
recommendations.description: Self-guided gravel route through the Walla Walla Valley followed by Fall Release events; choose route based on rain and road conditions.
recommendations.why: Combines your endurance riding with the strongest local seasonal event.

recommendations.title: Raging River Fall MTB Ride
recommendations.timing: Sat or Sun; check trails before riding
recommendations.weather: Wet roots, mud, and cold; verify trail status
recommendations.description: Self-guided ride of established Raging River routes and newer descents only where open; do not ride trails closed for work or weather.
recommendations.why: Worthwhile destination ride if conditions hold; pair with Soirée Saturday evening.

recommendations.title: Badger / Candy Mountain Ultra Hill Session
recommendations.weather: Cool, breezy; exposed ridges
recommendations.description: Self-guided trail run or hill-repeat session on local established trails; no organized race or meetup claimed.
recommendations.why: Low-friction climbing mileage for spring ultra preparation.

recommendations.title: West Richland Veterans Day Parade
recommendations.location: Van Giesen Street, West Richland, WA
recommendations.weather: Outdoor; cool morning
recommendations.description: Regional Veterans Day parade on West Van Giesen; official Tri-Cities tourism calendar confirms date and time.
recommendations.why: Easy local community event when not traveling.

recommendations.title: Yakima Valley Día de los Muertos Celebration
recommendations.timing: Fri Nov 6–Sat Nov 7; Sat dancers 1 PM
recommendations.weather: Indoor mall and outdoor travel
recommendations.description: Community altar exhibit 11 AM–5 PM, with Aztec dancers Friday and Los Bailadores del Sol Saturday.
recommendations.why: Distinct cultural event that can pair with a Yakima ride or film.

recommendations.title: Desert Fiber Arts Fall Market
recommendations.weather: Indoor
recommendations.description: Annual regional fiber-arts market listed by Visit Tri-Cities.
recommendations.why: Nearby alternative for a low-key weekend.
